title: lantana aculeata f. parvifolia
intro: Lantana aculeata f. parvifolia, commonly known as Dwarf Buttonbush, is a shrub-like plant that belongs to the Verbenaceae family and is native to tropical and subtropical regions of the world. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Lantana aculeata f. parvifolia are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, which are mediated by its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the mechanisms and efficacy of this plant in treating various health conditions.
